standard_prerequisites.name: The degrees in which the cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex is nonzero and the bound on the dimension of the support of each of them
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked early in the counted proof (source lines 3659-3663) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the top cohomology module of the complex and lets the proof kill the lower ones by a single element.

standard_prerequisites.name: Prime avoidance, the truncation triangle of a complex, and the vanishing of an endomorphism of a truncation below the truncation degree
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3665-3677) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces an element outside the minimal primes of maximal dimension that kills the truncated part, so that a power of it factors through the top cohomology module.

core_obligations: Set up the modules: the proof lists the minimal primes of maximal dimension, recalls that only the degrees between -d and 0 of the dualizing complex are nonzero and that the support of the i-th cohomology has dimension at most i, and writes the top cohomology module (proof lines 3657-3664)

Kill the lower part: by prime avoidance there is an element outside all the minimal primes of maximal dimension that annihilates every lower cohomology module of the dualizing complex (proof lines 3665-3667)

Factor through the top: the truncation triangle and the vanishing of an endomorphism of the truncated complex below the truncation degree produce a map from the dualizing complex to a shift of the top cohomology module whose composite with the natural map back is multiplication by a power of that element (proof lines 3668-3683)

Conclude: hence that power annihilates the top local cohomology of the top module, the divisibility statement turns this into its vanishing, and the criterion for the vanishing of top local cohomology of a module of full support gives the strict bound, since the top module is nonzero at the minimal primes (proof lines 3684-3690)
proof_roadmap: 设 d = dim A，p_1,…,p_n 是 d 维极小素。ω_A^∙ 仅在第 -d..0 阶非零，H^{-i}(ω_A^∙) 的支撑维数 ≤ i（lemma-sitting-in-degrees）；记 ω_A = H^{-d}(ω_A^∙)。

由素躲避取 f ∉ ⋃p_i 使 f 零化一切 i < d 的 H^{-i}(ω_A^∙)；截断三角 + 截断下自同态消没给出 ω_A^∙ → ω_A[d]，其与 ω_A[d] → ω_A^∙ 的复合是 f^d，故 f^d 零化 H^d_{V(I)}(ω_A)；由 lemma-top-coh-divisible 得 H^d_{V(I)}(ω_A) = 0，再用 lemma-cd-top-vanishing-some-module 与 (ω_A)_{p_i} ≠ 0 得 cd(A,I) < d。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement deduces a strict bound on the cohomological dimension of an ideal from the vanishing of the zeroth local cohomology of the normalized dualizing complex of a Noetherian local ring (author lemma at source lines 3648-3654, label lemma-cd-bound-dualizing). The proof (source lines 3656-3691) uses the degree and support bounds for the cohomology of the dualizing complex to isolate the top one, picks by prime avoidance an element outside the minimal primes of maximal dimension killing all lower cohomology modules, and then uses the truncation triangle together with the vanishing of an endomorphism of a truncation to factor a power of that element through the top module (proof lines 3668-3683); the divisibility and vanishing criteria of this chapter then conclude. The triangulated-category step that turns the annihilation into a factorisation is the content. H3.
